mapper.sql: A.ACC_SQ, A.ACC_NM, A.FROM_NM, A.FROM_ADDR, A.APP_PW_ENC, A.REPLY_TO, A.BCC, A.CONTACT, A.VERIFIED_YN, A.VERIFY_MSG , DATE_FORMAT(A.VERIFIED_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS VERIFIED_DT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM TB_EEP_MAIL_ACCOUNT_M A ORDER BY A.ACC_SQ
SELECT , U.FROM_NM AS USE_FROM_NM FROM TB_EEP_MAIL_USE_M U JOIN TB_EEP_MAIL_ACCOUNT_M A ON A.ACC_SQ = U.ACC_SQ WHERE U.USE_CD = #{useCd}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_MAIL_ACCOUNT_M (ACC_NM, FROM_NM, FROM_ADDR, APP_PW_ENC, REPLY_TO, BCC, CONTACT, UPDT_EMPLY_ID) VALUES (#{ACC_NM}, #{FROM_NM}, #{FROM_ADDR}, #{APP_PW_ENC}, NULLIF(#{REPLY_TO}, ''), NULLIF(#{BCC}, ''), NULLIF(#{CONTACT}, ''), #{EMPLY_ID})
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_MAIL_ACCOUNT_M SET VERIFIED_YN = #{VERIFIED_YN}, VERIFIED_DT = NOW(), VERIFY_MSG = #{VERIFY_MSG} WHERE ACC_SQ = #{ACC_SQ}
mapper.select: SELECT U.USE_CD, U.ACC_SQ, U.FROM_NM, U.TO_LIST FROM TB_EEP_MAIL_USE_M U
mapper.update: UPDATE TB_EEP_MAIL_USE_M SET ACC_SQ = #{ACC_SQ}, FROM_NM = #{FROM_NM}, TO_LIST = NULLIF(#{TO_LIST}, ''), UPDT_EMPLY_ID = #{EMPLY_ID} WHERE USE_CD = #{USE_CD}
mapper.select: SELECT E.EMPLY_ID, E.EMPLY_NM, NULLIF(TRIM(E.EMPLY_EMAIL), '') AS EMAIL , (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(R.ROLE_NM ORDER BY R.SORT_NO, R.ROLE_SQ SEPARATOR ', ') FROM TB_EEP_USER_ROLE_R U JOIN TB_EEP_ROLE_M R ON R.ROLE_SQ = U.ROLE_SQ WHERE U.EMPLY_ID = E.EMPLY_ID) AS ROLE_NMS FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E WHERE IFNULL(E.USE_YN, 'Y') = 'Y' AND IFNULL(E.DEL_YN, 'N') = 'N' ORDER BY E.EMPLY_NM
SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(EMPLY_EMAIL), '') FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M WHERE EMPLY_ID = #{emplyId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO TB_EEP_MAIL_CONF_H (TARGET, SUMMARY, EMPLY_ID) VALUES (#{TARGET}, #{SUMMARY}, #{EMPLY_ID})
mapper.select: SELECT H.TARGET, H.SUMMARY, DATE_FORMAT(H.REG_DT, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS REG_DT, H.EMPLY_ID , (SELECT E.EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_EMPLY_M E WHERE E.EMPLY_ID = H.EMPLY_ID LIMIT 1) AS EMPLY_NM FROM TB_EEP_MAIL_CONF_H H ORDER BY H.HIST_SQ DESC LIMIT 200
